comments.text:
What would make YOU stay in a remote Scottish glen — surrounded by mountains, wild weather, and almost no neighbors? 🏴
For generations, people left the Scottish Highlands, and some entire communities disappeared. Yet today, something fascinating is happening: people are beginning to return.
👇 If you have Scottish roots, tell us where your family came from. And if you don’t — would you choose to live here?
I’d love to know where everyone is watching from! 🌍❤
